rows.en: Murk: "Confound it! What in the world is going on?!
Have you still not finished checking security?!"
Staff Member: "Repairs are underway! Restoring it will take
at least one ris (about 40 minutes)!"
Murk: "Make it 35 deo (about 14 minutes)!
Honestly, the lot of you! Can't you work more efficiently?!
Hey! Er... Where's that one? What's the name...?"
Staff Member: "Do you mean Marsha?"
Murk: "Oh, yes, that's the one.
Well, then... Where's Mar... whatever...?"
Assistant: "Hmm? Did you call me, Professor?"
Murk: "...What are you doing inside the equipment locker?"
Assistant: "Eheh heh heh... Just taking a little nap..."
Murk: "Hmm. I see."
Staff Member: "Er, I don't think you're supposed to accept that..."
Murk: "...Hm? What's that bizarre machine on your back?"
Assistant: "What do you mean...? It's the
'Universal Integrated Communications and Observation Device' you developed, Professor."
Murk: "Hmm. What a peculiar name,
but if I made it, its performance must be sound.
Hmm. Now that I look closely, it looks rather cool too.
It suits you."
Assistant: "Eheh heh... D-do you think so?"
Murk: "That was a lie."
Assistant: "I'm crushed..."
Staff Member: "Er, as I said, I don't think this is the time
for this sort of conversation..."
Murk: "Hmm. Quite right.
Hey, are you the cause of all this?
It was you, wasn't it?! No, it must have been you!"
Assistant: "N-no, it wasn't me!"
Murk: "Hmm. If it wasn't you, then who was it?
Who would cause this much damage
to the institute...?"
Staff Member: "I-it couldn't possibly be me!"
Murk: "What? A power failure?
What happened to the emergency power?!"
Staff Member: "Emergency power is online!"
Murk: "I can see that without being told!
Why didn't the emergency power come on right away?
Hurry up and investigate!"
Assistant: "Ah... Th-this is terrible!"
Murk: "Again...? How many terrible things does that make today?"
Assistant: "The experimental creatures... have escaped."
Murk: "Such a trivial...!! E-escaped, you say?!
What do you mean?!"
Staff Member: "It seems the field was breached
in the brief time the power was out! 0021, 0033, 0048,
0049 and others, eighteen specimens in all, have left the grounds!"
Murk: "Hmm... WHAAAAAAT?!
Did you say 0033?!"
Assistant: "Isn't 0033 the one you modified
as a hobby, Professor...?"
Staff Member: "That's why I kept telling you
not to give it a self-replication function..."
Murk: "Confound it! What a disaster! Honestly,
now they'll cut my budget yet again..."
Staff Member: "I don't think that's the real problem here..."
Murk: "Never mind such trivial details!
The field has been restored, hasn't it?"
Assistant: "Yes, the security malfunction seems to be fixed too."
Murk: "Perhaps I skimped a little too much on security...
No... This is too convenient... The timing is too perfect...
Run a virus check as well, just in case.
Though I doubt you'll find anything..."
Assistant: "P-Professor..."
Murk: "What?!"
Assistant: "Some of the escaped specimens have headed
to the west."
Staff Member: "West...? That would mean... York, wouldn't it?
If I remember correctly, Zigrim is invading there right now...
Professor, isn't this rather bad...?"
Murk: "...I know nothing. I haven't heard a thing.
My ears are on holiday!"
Staff Member: "There you go acting like a child again..."
Murk: "...Hm? O-of course!
This is a chance to gather data on how the specimens
behave in the wild!
Mwah ha ha ha... More valuable data for me..."
Staff Member: "Um? Professor...?"
Murk: "Right! Now that it's decided, we must act at once!
All aboard! We're off!"
Assistant: "Huh?! W-wait, Professor!
M-me too?"
Murk: "Stop quibbling and follow me! Let's go!"
Assistant: "Ah, wait for me! Professor!"
Staff Member: "...He's run away again..."
Ymir: "How was Ai?"
Touya: "She seems to have calmed down for now. She's asleep."
Ymir: "I see... When Ai came to this world,
Lady Alforina was the very first person to become her friend.
At first, Ai wouldn't speak to anyone
and often spent her time alone.
Lady Alforina was concerned about her and kept speaking to her,
and gradually, Ai began to open her heart."
Touya: "Why...? Why did someone like that have to
die...? I can't forgive this... I'll never forgive it..."
Ymir: "I understand how you feel. But such unadulterated
negative emotions don't just harm the Spirit Mechs;
they also bring nothing good to the pilots themselves."
Touya: "But people are emotional creatures.
We can't always stay calm."
Ymir: "...You're right.
To be honest, I too feel a great deal of anger.
But giving ourselves over to that anger and seeking revenge
surely isn't what Lady Alforina would want.
What we must do is prepare for Ze=Ode's
return, and keep the land from being drenched
in any more tears of sorrow."
Touya: "Tears of sorrow... huh."
Clovis: "I've picked up an odd reading.
I thought it might be an instrument failure, but apparently not."
Ymir: "An odd reading?"
Clovis: "Readings for living creatures and Armored Mechs
are mixed together. And they're coming from the same body."
Ymir: "Machinery and living organisms... Could it be...?"
Arthur: "It seems we have no time to think about it.
They're almost here."
Ymir: "...I've confirmed them here too.
...From the direction of Agarthia, just as I thought...
We'd almost reached the rendezvous..."
Touya: "Is that ship, the Liebhofen or whatever, up ahead?"
Ymir: "Yes. But it seems we have no choice but to fight here."
Touya: "Got it. I'll go out too. As for Ai..."
Ymir: "Yes. It's only a matter of time before she notices, but
I won't tell her."
Touya: "Sorry for the trouble. I'm heading out, then."
Ymir: "I was right to leave Ai in your care.
Take care, Touya..."
Touya: "Y-yeah!"

review_batches.context: Examined all 130 s_005 rows, all 60 s_004 rows and all 565 s_003 rows. Murk and his assistant discover security damage, a power interruption and eighteen escaped experimental creatures. Murk forgets Marsha's name, jokes at her expense, then suspects suspicious timing while trying to avoid responsibility. The second half moves to grief after Alforina's death and an encounter with the escaped creatures.
review_batches.decisions: Keep the source labels Staff Member and Assistant even though Marsha is named in the conversation. Preserve all specimen IDs, eighteen total, both fictional time units and the source's approximate real-minute conversions. Universal Integrated Communications and Observation Device is a full editorial device-name draft, deliberately cumbersome; do not truncate it for a byte budget. Security sabotage is suspected, not proven. Keep Murk's literal ears-on-holiday absurdity and his selfish concern about budget cuts.

row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o000b5.l00: The repair estimate continues into row 3; at least preserves the earliest possible completion limit.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o000b5.l01: Preserve one ris and the source's about 40 minutes. Do not silently convert away the fantasy unit.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o000f7.l00: Murk demands 35 deo, about 14 minutes, instead of accepting the staff estimate. Preserve both figures rather than treating them as an error.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o000f7.l02: Deliberate failure to recall the assistant's name.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o0016e.l01: Mar... whatever deliberately cuts off the name Marsha, matching Murk's established forgetfulness.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o001fe.l00: The assistant's nap excuse deliberately trails off.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o00239.l00: The staff member objects to Murk accepting the excuse; the comment deliberately trails off.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o00288.l00: The source's sentence spans the two rows; complete the device name in row 17.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o002f9.l00: Continuation of Murk's preceding speech despite a new source block with no speaker label.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o00350.l00: The written impact/shock interjection becomes an explicit crushed reaction to Murk's lie; no injury is invented.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o00364.l00: The objection continues in row 26 and deliberately trails off.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o003f2.l01: The question continues across rows 31..33 before the staff member denies responsibility.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o00542.l00: The assistant's repeated terrible report motivates Murk's next joke.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o005b1.l00: Murk begins dismissing the problem as trivial, then interrupts himself on recognizing an escape.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o005e4.l01: Specimen IDs remain literal, including leading zeroes and their original order.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o005e4.l02: The listed four IDs are examples among eighteen escaped specimens, not the entire count.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o00675.l00: The assistant's reminder deliberately continues and trails off at row 52.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o006ab.l00: The staff member's reminder continues into row 54; self-replication is an explicit modification.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o007a5.l01: Murk changes his mind about mere cost-cutting and suspects timing too convenient to be accidental; no perpetrator is named.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o007a5.l03: His pessimism about finding a virus remains an opinion, not a verified scan result.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o0088b.l00: The staff member infers York from westward movement, rather than establishing every specimen's destination.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o0088b.l02: Deliberate unfinished warning about the danger of escapees entering an invasion.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o008ec.l01: Keep the absurd literal holiday excuse; the following staff reply explicitly calls his conduct childish.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o00940.l01: The proposed data opportunity spans rows 76..77.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o009b2.l00: Deliberate puzzled address at Murk's self-serving plan.

review_batches.context: Examined all s_003..s_005 rows (755 total). Murk leaves under the pretext of gathering field data. The scene changes to Ymir and Touya discussing Ai's grief and Alforina's death. Mixed biological/mechanical contacts approach before the Liebhofen rendezvous, and Touya asks that sleeping Ai not be disturbed.
review_batches.decisions: Do not merge the laboratory humor into the mourning scene. Alforina's death is explicit here; do not invent the killer's identity, gender or the missing battlefield details. Restore subjects without weakening Touya's anger. Ymir warns about undiluted negative emotion and invokes Alforina's wishes; she admits her own anger rather than merely lecturing him. Agarthia is a direction in this exchange. Ymir agrees to withhold notice of the battle from Ai; Touya is going out to fight, not ordering Ymir to leave.

row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o009d0.l01: Murk's departure cry is comic; All aboard conveys the stock train-departure expression without inventing an actual train.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o00a07.l01: The assistant's incredulous question asks whether she must accompany him.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o00a8d.l00: The staff member means Murk has evaded responsibility again; do not make this a new specimen escape.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o00b4c.l00: Ymir's explanation continues into row 90; Alforina was Ai's first friend after arrival in this world.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o00bfd.l00: Touya's question continues into row 96. Alforina's death is explicit, but the killer and details are not supplied here.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o00bfd.l01: Keep full force of Touya's inability to forgive; use this/it rather than invent a named or gendered killer.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o00c44.l00: The warning spans rows 97..99; unadulterated preserves the source's purity of negative emotion, not a general prohibition on all feelings.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o00ce0.p01.l00: Same speech continues across FE pages; negative feelings are not silently cut and the queen's wishes are not rewritten into a revenge order.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o00ce0.p02.l00: Ze=Ode's return and preventing further sorrow form one sentence over rows 106..108.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o00d90.l00: Touya deliberately repeats the metaphor rather than adding a conclusion.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o00e19.l00: Both biological and machine readings come from the same entity; do not make these two separate groups of enemies.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o00e58.l00: Ymir's recognition is deliberately unfinished. Do not identify a creature not yet named.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o00eaf.l01: Deliberately trailing direction assessment. Agarthia refers to the approaching direction, not the entire world as a location outside itself.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o00eaf.l02: Rendezvous is inferred from the immediately following question about the Liebhofen up ahead; no alternate destination is invented.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o00f4a.l00: Touya volunteers to fight, then deliberately trails off on Ai; Ymir completes the shared thought by agreeing not to tell her.
row_decisions.scenario.s_005.o00fbb.l00: Ymir says entrusting Ai to Touya was the right decision; keep the care direction explicit.
